s0.p2: Creates an instance with binary data.
s0.p3: There is no direct access to the data in the ⟦f0⟧ instance.
s0.p4: Only the length of the buffer in bytes is readable.
s0.p5: Typed arrays have a fixed length and are used to store data in binary format (raw data).
s0.p6: Data in typed arrays can only be accessed through **views**, there is no direct access.
s0.p7: Binary data stored in a typed array can be interpreted as a string, as an audio or video file, as an image, or as an array of numbers.
s0.p8: The **TypedArray** constructor is also not directly available, and can be referenced from the inheritance chain of any instance.
s1.p1: To work with **⟦f0⟧** instance data, you must use constructors that instantiate **accessors**.
